verdict.rationale: Zep explicitly generates and incrementally updates natural-language thread summaries (zep-docs-8), and these summaries feed into the Context Block returned via thread.add_messages/get_user_context so an agent can resume with prior session context (zep-docs-10, zep-docs-11, zep-docs-49). Framework integrations persist conversation turns and retrieve this context automatically for supported agent frameworks (zep-docs-24, zep-docs-51). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating summary accuracy or continuity in real multi-session use, only first-party docs are cited.
